title: Initial machine configuration
statement: For either Boolean mode and every Boolean input word $z$, the evaluator's initial configuration on $z$ is the configuration in state $	ext{rd1}(	ext{n0})$ with the input head at position $1$, both work tapes blank with both heads at position $0$, and an empty output word.
